decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Refusal

1.	The proposed change of use from A1 (Grocers and Butcher) to A3 (Restaurant and Takeaway) would result in a loss of amenity for neighbouring residents by way of increased odour and noise generation and is considered contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and S.2.2 (Non-Retail Uses in Other Shopping Areas) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003. 

2.              Due to the location of the proposed restaurant and takeaway facility on a busy local road and the failure to provide any off-street parking, conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic would result, which is considered to be contrary to Adopted UDP policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.1 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Change of use from A1 (Butchers) to A3 (Restaurant and takeaway) incorporating the installation of a rear ventilation shaft.
